Abu Maryam al-Fihri, also known as Fareh, was a companion who possessed immense wisdom and generosity. As a devout Muslim, he was known for his piety and dedication to Islam. The name Fareh carries a deep spiritual meaning, reminding us of the importance of wisdom, generosity, and piety in our own lives.
